models.summary: Fixed-charge coverage adds lease payments to EBIT and compares the result with interest plus lease payments.

relationship.original_equation: Fixed-charge coverage = (EBIT + lease payments) / (interest payments + lease payments)
relationship.translation_notes: Interest payments and EBIT are distinct cash and accrual measures; their conventions must be matched to the source definition.
